# Prepare borough index mapping
boroughs = sorted(main_df['borough'].unique())
n_boroughs = len(boroughs)
borough_to_index = {borough: idx for idx, borough in enumerate(boroughs)}

# Initialize spatial weights matrix
weights = np.zeros((n_boroughs, n_boroughs))

# Populate weights matrix
for _, row in adj_df.iterrows():
    boro = row['borough']
    neighbor = row['neighbor']
    if boro in borough_to_index and neighbor in borough_to_index:
        i = borough_to_index[boro]
        j = borough_to_index[neighbor]
        weights[i, j] = 1

# Set diagonal to zero (no self-neighbors)
np.fill_diagonal(weights, 0)

# Row-standardize weights
row_sums = weights.sum(axis=1)
for i in range(n_boroughs):
    if row_sums[i] > 0:
